description: A single file to add to the code interpreter session, pairing the fileHandleAssociation that identifies the file's content with the session path where it should appear.

fileHandleAssociation.description: The association identifying the file's content, as returned by the get-files-metadata tool.

sessionPath.description: The path where the file should appear in the session filesystem (e.g. 'entity_metadata_specialist/data.csv').
